question: Can independent subcolony counting error alone create an apparent within-island beta-variability signal as large as the observed hierarchical separation?

eligible_units.reason: Same stable-roster units as the frozen primary hierarchical decomposition.

latent_complete_synchrony_null.fixed_composition: For each island, q_j is the colony-code share of cumulative breeding pairs across all 1991-2017 censuses.
latent_complete_synchrony_null.latent_mean: lambda_jt = observed island total N_t * q_j
latent_complete_synchrony_null.interpretation: Every latent subcolony trajectory within an island is exactly proportional to the island total, so latent within-island beta variability equals one before observation error is added.
latent_complete_synchrony_null.island_trajectories: Observed island totals are retained as latent annual means so the empirical among-island trajectory structure is not destroyed.

error_model_reuse: Same Poisson and independent Gamma-Poisson multiplicative-CV families used in the frozen N_eff mechanical-coupling diagnostic.

primary_statistics.raw_beta_within: Wang-Loreau beta from colony-code units to islands.
primary_statistics.raw_beta_among: Wang-Loreau beta from islands to the three-island aggregate.
primary_statistics.raw_log_beta_contrast: log(beta_within / beta_among); one-sided Monte Carlo tail against the observed frozen value.

fixed_centered_sensitivities.linear_detrended_log1p: Median within-island covariance beta divided by among-island covariance beta.
fixed_centered_sensitivities.annual_log1p_growth: Median within-island covariance beta divided by among-island covariance beta.
fixed_centered_sensitivities.boundary: These are non-additive sensitivities only; they are not alpha/gamma decompositions.

decision_rules.measurement_error_robust_raw_hierarchy: Observed raw log-beta contrast must be in the upper 5% tail under all three frozen error models.
decision_rules.centered_signal_robustness: Centered-signal ratios are reported as fixed diagnostics, not promoted if compatible with the error-only null.
decision_rules.no_model_tuning: Do not add intermediate CV values, alternative fixed-share definitions, correlated-error structures, or extra transformations unless an external empirical error calibration is obtained.

interpretation_boundary: Failure under an error model does not prove that counting error caused the observed hierarchy.
Success under an error model does not calibrate actual Palmer observer error.
The diagnostic tests measurement-error robustness of the hierarchy, not the N_eff coefficient.
The raw additive abundance decomposition remains the only exact Wang-Loreau alpha/beta/gamma partition.
